title: DSP loader
author: irpina
description: DSP code at run time for the Octatrack: a mod that isn't flashed (a TELOS mod from the card) hands its DSP code to ot_dsp_load, and from the next audio frames it runs on DSP core 0 as an ev_dsp_rx handler. The code goes into the DSP window's clear gap (597 words), sent to DSP core 1 over the host port and copied there by a copier that takes SPATIALIZER's code space on core 1 (after sambanks/octabam's demand loader, MIT). Needs the DSP bus.
